annotation.authors_or_issuer: Jones, L.; Shahzad, S.; Sana, A.; Pizzuto, G.
key_provisions_or_claims: Ensemble of recurrent imitation-learning policies estimates epistemic uncertainty via action variance.
Kernel density estimation calibrates a safety threshold on success-conditioned variance.
Hybrid controller switches to a rule-based backup controller when uncertainty exceeds the threshold.
Improves task success and reduces safety violations across three lab manipulation tasks versus single-policy baselines.
Zero-shot sim-to-real transfer demonstrated on a Franka Production 3 arm.
annotation.summary_en: Preprint proposing SAFE-CHEM, an uncertainty-aware hybrid controller for robotic chemistry. An imitation-learning ensemble quantifies epistemic uncertainty and switches to a rule-based backup controller above a calibrated threshold. It improves success and reduces safety violations in simulation and transfers zero-shot to a Franka robot. It is a technical safety paper, not a governance document.
annotation.title_clean: SAFE-CHEM: Uncertainty-Aware Policy Switching for Robust Robotic Chemistry
annotation.title_en: SAFE-CHEM: Uncertainty-Aware Policy Switching for Robust Robotic Chemistry
